title: Detailed trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Trophy cup body -->
  <path d='M30 18 Q30 48 50 48 Q70 48 70 18 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Cup shine/highlight -->
  <path d='M36 20 Q38 42 46 46 Q42 42 40 20 Z' fill='#FFFACD' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Cup rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='15' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <rect x='28' y='15' width='44' height='3' rx='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <path d='M28 22 Q14 22 14 34 Q14 46 28 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 22 Q17 24 17 34 Q17 44 28 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d='M72 22 Q86 22 86 34 Q86 46 72 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 22 Q83 24 83 34 Q83 44 72 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Star/decoration on cup -->
  <polygon points='50,26 52,32 58,32 53,36 55,42 50,38 45,42 47,36 42,32 48,32' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='8' height='16' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <rect x='48' y='48' width='3' height='16' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Stem knob -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFB300'/>
  
  <!-- Base top tier -->
  <rect x='38' y='64' width='24' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <rect x='38' y='64' width='24' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Base bottom tier -->
  <rect x='32' y='69' width='36' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='32' y='69' width='36' height='3' rx='2' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  
  <!-- Base plaque -->
  <rect x='40' y='72' width='20' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Engraved text lines on plaque -->
  <rect x='44' y='73' width='12' height='1.5' rx='0.5' fill='#FFB300' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='46' y='75' width='8' height='1' rx='0.5' fill='#FFB300' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Extra shine dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Cup bottom curve detail -->
  <path d='M32 44 Q50 50 68 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Laurel wreath hints on base -->
  <path d='M35 70 Q38 73 41 70' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M65 70 Q62 73 59 70' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
